title: Safe Treatment for Emergency Presentation for Suicidal Ideation and Behavior in Youth
official: Youth Partners in Care for Suicide Prevention
summary: This randomized comparative effectiveness trial will compare two evidence-based approaches to emergency care for youth ages 13-24 who present to the Emergency Department (ED) with suicidal ideation or behavior. Outcomes will be monitored at baseline and at 3, 6 \& 12 month follow-up assessments.

interventions.name: Combined SAFETY-A within usual ED Care + CLASP Therapeutic Follow-Up Contacts

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 13-24;
* past-week suicidal behavior or ideation with plan or intent

Exclusion Criteria:

* symptoms or illness that precludes informed consent or engagement in study procedures (e.g., active psychosis; drug dependence, no locator information);
* youth not fluent in English
* parent not fluent in English or Spanish.
